authorization_prerequisites: measured or explicitly source-referenced array/CSI/quantization calibration envelope
null-floor-aware protected-tone fallback with exact floor/outage audit
independent review of immutable campaign bundle
primary_hypothesis: Under identical information, delay, slew, traffic, criterion, and uncertainty conditions, robust predictive constrained-PF control achieves zero hard-safety violations and a positive paired fairness-utility advantage over safe static, delayed-myopic, virtual-queue, common-scale, hard-null, and power-backoff baselines.

phase_0_calibration.purpose: Characterize complex gain/phase residuals, their spatial/frequency/temperature correlation, steering/orientation error, CSI error, quantization, and achieved null depth.
phase_0_calibration.required_output: calibrated upper envelope or explicitly deterministic engineering envelope
phase_0_calibration.execution_location: measurement/OTA platform or documented source data; not Nibi

phase_1_paired_primary.replication_unit: channel/topology seed crossed with protected pass
phase_1_paired_primary.criterion: joint long-term design with separately reported short-term verification
phase_1_paired_primary.array: practical primary architecture after phase-0 calibration

phase_2_factor_sensitivities.rule: Run one factor block at a time using paired common random numbers; do not execute the full Cartesian product.

phase_3_confirmatory_holdout.rule: Freeze algorithms, thresholds, uncertainty envelope, and primary metrics before opening this block.

primary_endpoints: hard-safety violation count and maximum excess
statistics.go_condition: All hard-safety checks pass with no hidden slack and the paired predictive-versus-safe-static fairness-utility confidence interval excludes zero.
